title: AOS-4 Independent Verification Foundation
description: Implement the generic deterministic independent-verification foundation. Introduce a verification-result contract and verifier boundary that consumes an existing ControlledExecutionResult and evidence metadata without executing or mutating the worker task. The verifier must produce PASS or HOLD-style verification output, must fail closed on malformed or contradictory evidence, and must not permit the executor result alone to authorize canonical closure.
